svg.aria-label: jeff, one system in three layers. Left: the graph layer drains a task DAG (A and B unblock C, D independent) into a deterministic ready set, atomic claims and three isolated worktree lanes, then a serialized integration pass, immutable checkpoint, one full-suite gate, review with conditional audit and an expected-old ref update. Middle, shown as a detail of one lane: the task loop runs plan and tests, implement or execute, conditional refactor, a checkpoint-bound full suite, then review or verify and conditional audit across the builder-judge boundary, into a done gate and a green task. Right, shown as a detail of the judgment stations: a cap dispatches three mutually blind inquiry specialists, Jeff deterministically derives each finding's vote result, a fourth fresh synthesis specialist selects typed recovery, and one lineage-preserving recovery episode returns through a fresh gate and judgment before done or return to the Chef. Jeff routes every layer, the plain-file ledger records every layer, and durable memory is written only on an explicit Remember.
